name: Measures for Security Assessment of Outbound Data Transfer
description: Implements PIPL Article 40 and DSL cross-border provisions. Requires a CAC security assessment before export of 'important data' or personal information above defined thresholds (e.g. CIIOs, processors handling PI of 1M+ individuals, or sensitive PI of 10,000+ individuals) collected/generated in China. Companion lower-threshold mechanisms (standard contract, certification) were introduced in later 2023 relaxation rules.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Cyberspace Administration of China (cac.gov.cn) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Cyberspace Administration of China (cac.gov.cn).
